name: Fieldstone Home Hearth
blurb: A tall fieldstone chimney-breast with a log fire laid in the grate and a timber mantel above, the heart of a warm, lived-in house.

era.note: Plain fieldstone hearth with no race, skill or event styling in the art. The art first shipped in 2003 as a winter-gift deed, but the object is ordinary period furnishing.

implNote: Server.Items.HearthOfHomeFire(east/south): two light-emitting tiles; decor-only, shown lit

name: Gilded Marble Hearth
blurb: A small hearth of sand-gold marble, a flame dancing behind carved scrollwork and a gleaming trim.

era.note: A generic marble fireplace in a gilded stone, ordinary grand-house furnishing with no expansion theme. Art is from the later decor block; the release date is unverified.

implNote: one tile per facing (animated flame, first frame); decor-only

name: Slate-Roofed Hearth
blurb: An open iron-posted hearth capped with a slab of grey slate, a steady fire glowing in its cage.

era.note: A generic iron-and-slate fireplace; nothing in it belongs to a later race, skill or creature. Art is from the later decor block; the release date is unverified.

implNote: one tile per facing (animated flame, first frame); decor-only

name: Green Marble Hearth
blurb: A mossy-green marble hearth, cool veined stone around a bright, cheerful fire.

era.note: A generic marble fireplace in a green stone, plain furnishing. Art is from the later decor block; the release date is unverified.

implNote: one tile per facing (animated flame, first frame); decor-only

name: Great Bonfire
blurb: A towering blaze roaring in a ring of heavy stones, built for feast nights and long gatherings under the stars.

era.note: A generic stone-ringed bonfire. Nothing in the art ties it to an expansion or creature. Art is from the later decor block; the release date is unverified.

implNote: static (animated flame, first frame); strip the damage flag for a house item

name: Log-Stack Campfire
blurb: Split logs stacked in a tepee over a bright, crackling flame, the traveller's oldest comfort.

era.note: A plain log campfire; era neutral because it is a universal camp object with no later-content styling. Art is from the later decor block; the release date is unverified.

implNote: static (animated flame, first frame); strip the damage flag for a house item

name: Bronze Fire Bowl on a Stand
blurb: A shallow bronze bowl heaped with burning coals, held up on a slender three-footed stand.

era.note: A generic bronze standing brazier with no expansion theme. Art is from the later decor block; the release date is unverified.

name: Squat Iron Lamp Post
blurb: A short round-footed lamp post for a doorstep or garden path, its yellow glass lit all night.

era.note: Original-era lamp post graphic (0x0B22), plain town furniture. The main catalog uses it only as part of a street scene.

name: Slender Iron Lamp Post
blurb: A slim black lamp post on a stepped base, a yellow flame behind pale glass under a pointed cap.

era.note: A generic slender street lamp with no race, skill or creature styling. Art is from the later decor block; the release date is unverified.

name: Gallows Lantern Post
blurb: A stout timber post with a crooked arm, a hanging lantern swaying from its tip over the inn door.

era.note: Original-era lantern post and hanging lantern, composed here into the one object they were drawn to be. Both pieces are 1998-era art.

implNote: post 0x0A1F/0x0A20 plus a hanging lantern 0x0A1A at dz 16 on the arm tip (east: dx+1, south: dy+1)

name: Dragon-Wrapped Oil Lamp
blurb: A burnished-bronze dragon coiled around a glass bulb of lamp oil, its flame glowing amber inside.

era.note: A bronze dragon (a launch-era monster) curled round a plain oil bulb; no later creature or race. Stygian Abyss-era decor art, 2009 onward.

name: Dragon Egg Lamp
blurb: A small winged wyrm clasping a glowing, speckled egg, a lamp for a dragon-tamer's study.
